Class JdbcTargetExtractor

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.instrumentation.JdbcTargetExtractor
public final class JdbcTargetExtractor extends Object
Reflective pool-identifier extraction helpers for intercepted JDBC pool calls.

HikariCP and c3p0 are compileOnly dependencies; they may or may not be on the application classpath at runtime. Accessing their types via Method.invoke(Object, Object...) keeps the instrumentation module free of any hard link.

Failures are swallowed and returned as null — the caller treats a null pool name as "no pool filter will match" which matches the NamePattern.any() selector default.

    • fromHikariPool

      public static @Nullable String fromHikariPool(@Nullable Object pool)
      Extracts the HikariCP pool name. HikariPool declares no getPoolName() (only HikariDataSource and HikariConfig do); its PoolBase holds the name in a protected field and returns it from toString(). A getPoolName() is used where a pool type has one, then a toString() the pool class declares itself, then the class name.
      Parameters:
      pool - the com.zaxxer.hikari.pool.HikariPool instance; may be null
      Returns:
      the pool name, or the class name as a fallback, or null when pool is null
